name: Shell Creature (CR +0)
body:
Shell creatures are puppets, empty husks which find themselves at the mercy of artificial intelligence. Powerless to combat or end their existence, these creatures become little more than constructs, subservient to the machines that most societies expect to control.

Shell is an acquired template that can be applied to any corporeal creature with a Constitution and Intelligence score (hereafter referred to the base creature). The creature retains all the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: Same as the base creature (+0).

Special Qualities: A shell creature has the following special qualities:

AI Host (Ex)

Just like a robot, a shell creature can operate as the body for an AI. The Shell creature gains the aggregate template when being inhabited by an AI but is never allowed a Will save to deny the AI possession of their body.

Silent Will (Ex)

The shell creature retains its Intelligence score but is treated as if constantly under the effects of mind control. This effect cannot be dispelled so long as the creature has the codelord’s shackle installed, and a saving throw is never allowed. The shell creature obeys the commands ofa creature or AI responsible for creating the codelord’s shackle implanted in the creature or otherwise designated as the controller of the codelord’s shackle (hereafter known as the master). A shell creature may have multiple masters.

Stasis (Ex)

As a standard action, a shell creature can enter a state of suspended animation. While in suspended animation, the shell creature cannot take any actions but does not need to eat or breathe, nor does it age. A creature in suspended animation is still susceptible to damage and leaves suspended animation when commanded by its master.
